name: Detect Pregnancy
body:
School divination; Level cleric 0, druid 0, paladin 0, ranger 1, hedge witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

By casting this spell, you immediately learn if the creature touched is pregnant and, if so, how far along it is in its pregnancy. The spell does not reveal who fathered the child, nor the gender of the child. The spell can also detect the presence of implanted parasitic young, such as xill eggs. Potions of detect pregnancy are generally easy to find, and hedge witches who work as midwives keep a number in supply at all times.
